description: This file defines the CurlFactoryInterface in the GuzzleHttp\Handler namespace, specifying methods for creating and releasing cURL handle resources, used for HTTP request handling.

classes.name: CurlFactoryInterface
classes.description: Interface declaring methods for creating and releasing cURL handles within Guzzle HTTP client.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a cURL handle resource based on the provided HTTP request and options.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases a given cURL handle, allowing it to be reused or closed.
